# Jamshed Ali

> Computer Systems Engineering Student at Sukkur IBA University, Full-Stack Developer, AI & Cybersecurity Researcher, and Founder/CEO of AuraNix Technologies.

Jamshed Ali is a software engineer and AI researcher based in Pakistan. He specializes in autonomous multi-agent systems, scalable web applications, enterprise software architectures, and cybersecurity. He is the founder of AuraNix Technologies (auranix.tech) and the lead organizer of WordPress Campus Connect at Sukkur IBA University.

## Core Projects & Research

- [Agentic AI for Autonomous Cyber-Defense](https://jamshedali.me/#portfolio): Multi-agent autonomous security framework conducting threat reconnaissance, automated triage, and proactive containment.
- [Zenith Cybersecurity Dashboard](https://jamshedali.me/#portfolio): Enterprise telemetry console for real-time network traffic inspection and threat analysis.
- [AuraNix Technologies Official Portal](https://auranix.tech/): Official digital platform and enterprise services portal.
- [Shikarpur Sweets E-Commerce](https://jamshedali.me/#portfolio): Production web platform with scalable order management and payment flows.
- [AuraWord Intelligent Processing](https://jamshedali.me/#portfolio): AI-powered document processing, OCR, and summarization tool.
